creationPrompt:
Create a operations scorecard for me as a Claw Me Page. Include where to act, definitions matter, review the target. Replace illustrative data, preserve relevant evidence and uncertainty, and check totals or percentages. Ask only for missing information in one concise batch: reporting period, measures and denominators, targets, data sources, owners and follow-up actions.

Use the Claw Me source at https://github.com/clawdotme/plugin in templates/operations-scorecard/index.html and templates/_shared/tailwind/README.md. Use semantic responsive HTML, working section links, and useful native details/summary interactions. No scripts, forms, tracking, or embedded frames in the static Page. Deliver matching HTML and PDF from the same content, expand disclosures for print, and inspect page breaks. Use a readable portrait PDF. PDF export is separate from Page publishing unless the current platform explicitly supports it.

exampleAnswers.Purpose and audience: Track operational measures with definitions, thresholds, and named follow-up actions.
exampleAnswers.Working context: This fictional monthly scorecard uses manually recorded service operations. Each measure has a definition and an owner so the team can investigate a change without guessing what the number means.
exampleAnswers.Example records:
Measure: Requests answered within two days · Observed: 18 of 20 · Working target: At least 18 of 20 · Owner: Sam
Measure: Maintenance checks recorded · Observed: 11 of 12 · Working target: 12 of 12 · Owner: Leo
Measure: Handover records complete · Observed: 4 of 5 · Working target: 5 of 5 · Owner: Maya
Measure: Unassigned open requests · Observed: 1 · Working target: 0 · Owner: Robin
exampleAnswers.Content decisions:
Where to act: Assign the open request today and recover the missing maintenance record. Review the incomplete handover with its owner before adding a new process to the whole team.
Definitions matter: The response measure counts a substantive first response, not an automatic acknowledgement. A maintenance check counts only when its result and date are recorded.
Review the target: Targets in this example are planning choices, not industry benchmarks. Compare several periods before interpreting a small change as a trend, especially when the sample is small.
exampleAnswers.Format and interaction: scorecard layout; section navigation and expandable detail where useful; matching portrait document PDF.
exampleAnswers.Sharing and provenance: A hypothetical example informed by Claw Me’s small-team and Agent workflows. These are not Pete’s actual clients, finances, travel plans, research results, or commitments. Keep the real adaptation private until the owner chooses to share.
